text: {"A": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": []}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["oc tlaneltoquiliz çolpan hueca teitzticatca (when we were still in the former state of belief, it was far off, watching us) -> 'when faith was still far off' (drops 'çolpan', the former or old state, and 'teitzticatca', 'watching us', and makes faith rather than salvation the thing that was far off)"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "Both translations are complete and accurate on the Spanish margin and the Latin, but A renders the Nahuatl clause about salvation once being far off in the former state of belief more faithfully, while B flattens it to 'when faith was still far off'."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["suffer"], "mistranslated": []}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": ["literal 'in the Language' (replaced by an interpretive note 'in the Mexican language')"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["y que peccados... son las que nos apartan (which of our sins are the ones that separate us) -> that our sins and wicked deeds are what separate and distance us from God"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A is complete and accurate apart from supplying the verb 'suffer' for the broken word 'cen', while B misreads 'y que peccados' as a statement rather than 'which sins', and replaces the closing 'en la Lengua' with an interpretation in a note."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": ["the second half of the doublet 'itequaltiayatzin i teyectiayatzin' (only 'grace' is given)"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["teotlahuiztli in tlanextlahuiztli (the divine armour/insignia, the armour of light, as in Rom. 13:12 'arma lucis') -> 'the divine light, the shining radiance'", "itlacemihtoltzin Dios (God's promise) -> 'God's decree'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["gloria (glory) -> 'Heaven' (a minor slip)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "Both translations are complete, but B correctly renders tlahuiztli as 'armor' (Paul's 'armour of light') and keeps the doublet for grace, while A turns the armour into 'light/radiance'."}
